items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] When I first met Janis Joplin... [INTERVIEWEE] Oh a lot of rock groups have done that.

ctx.x: to New York I dashed up to (Bud Powell), I said, Bud, you're the end. He said, 'yes? give me a job!' (LAUGHTER). That took care of me, I said, well......
When I first met Janis Joplin I sat in what was its Fillmore East, and heard her doing an exact copy of something that I had heard before. An exact copy.
Oh a lot of rock groups have done that.
